facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 61°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 1 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), June 7 (2024), June 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: left June 16; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 22 (2024), June 17 (2025)

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Brown Top (5,850 ft) and Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and the lowest at Beaver Pass (3,630 ft).

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: 15.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 34.1 in (2023), 27.0 in (2024), 31.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: 62.7 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 56.5 in (2023), 36.0 in (2024), 50.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: 95.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 89.3 in (2023), 71.0 in (2024), 87.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 22 and June 15, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 14, at the pass elevation; points to April 22 to June 4

evidence.name: Brown Top
evidence.detail: melted out June 16, 2,231 ft above the pass; points to March 31 to June 15

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 30, 1,661 ft above the pass; points to April 28 to July 5
